description: Merge non-major updates once the repository's checks pass. Majors, 0.x, prerelease and Python minor updates wait for review.

packageRules.description: Merge minor, patch and digest updates on their own
Before 1.0, a minor update may break the API. The pattern also covers ranges such as ^0.32.1 and Go pseudo-versions such as v0.2608.1-0.20260911...
Prerelease versions may break between releases
Python minor releases remove deprecated APIs
